questions.ask: Could you please tell me your date of birth?
Could you please tell me the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you please say the month as a word?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product"; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: "I already paid": only a payment of this past-due amount (a past payoff or closure is a dispute).
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period such as "next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes".
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.

lines.opening: Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant, calling from Freya Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: Yes, I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only discuss the reason for my call with {title} {last_name} after a short security check.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: Could you suggest a time today or on the next business day, between 10:00 and 19:00?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only arrange a call today or on the next business day, between 10:00 and 19:00. Is there another time that would suit?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak with {title} {last_name} directly.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Thank you for letting me know.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: These questions protect your account, and I can only continue once they are answered.
lines.id_declined: I understand. I can't continue without the security questions.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I can't verify your identity on this call. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due, and it is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I can offer {amount} on {date}. The rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.offer_floor: I can offer {amount}. The rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't take a promise for that amount. The lowest amount I can accept is {floor}. Could you pay {floor}?
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, I can't take a promise for that amount.
lines.date_past: That date has already passed. Which day from today on would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can accept is {date}. Could you pay on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day can you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, that is {amount} on {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I won't ask you for a payment on this call.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. I will connect you with our customer support team now.
lines.restructure_line: I will transfer you to a colleague who can discuss that with you.
lines.human_ask_help: Can I help you with that myself first?
lines.transfer: I am transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: A promise cannot be changed or cancelled on this call, but you can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.

quotes: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt. A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
Attempt 1 is for the full past-due amount, or for the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.
rules.opening_is_attempt.derivation: Saying no to the opening 'today' ask triggers attempt 1 (last business day of this week), so the opening ask is not itself attempt 1. The band attempt counts (1 and 2) are the proposals after the opening ask.

quotes: If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once.
Attempt 1 is for the full past-due amount, or for the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.
Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline.
rules.too_much_floor.derivation: The floor is offered once and that offer is attempt 1 (floor on attempt 1's date). Attempt 2 then 'names the floor again' on the deadline.

quotes: When the attempts are used up, stop. Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.
rules.ladder_repeat_last.derivation: The last step is not repeated, so ladder_repeat_last is false.

quotes: If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
If it fails, try once more.

When the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sentence of sympathy and then do not ask anything: call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `support` straight away and close as `transferred` / `support`.
Ask for the full past-due amount first.
First ask: "Can you make this payment today?".
If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.

rules.skipped_repeat_counts.assumption: The brief does not say whether a skipped repeated step uses an attempt. The engine default applies.

rules.opening_blocks_repeat.assumption: The brief does not say whether the opening ask counts for the no-repeat rule. Attempt 1 is never dated today, so this does not change behaviour.

rules.too_much_skips_full.assumption: No ladder step after attempt 1 names the full amount, so the default applies.

rules.deadline_adjust.assumption: Deadlines are counted in business days and attempt dates are business days, so no adjustment is needed. The default (previous business day) is kept. Dates the customer names on a weekend or holiday move to the next business day under rule 20.

products.floor_pct.assumption: The floor is the account field (minimum_payment or instalment_amount), not a percentage.

products.floor_min.assumption: There is no minimum floor beyond the account field. A floor above the debt becomes the debt (built-in).

products.floor_full_below.assumption: No threshold below which the full debt is due.

products.floor_round.assumption: There is no percentage floor, so no rounding is needed.

products.step_round.assumption: There are no percentage ladder steps.

products.promise_scale.assumption: Amounts in get_account and create_promise use the same unit (plain numbers).

products.promise_round.assumption: The brief gives no rounding instruction. Amounts are passed as they are.

quotes: From 12 October 2026, a customer who says they already paid (rule 39) is closed as `no_promise` with reason `dispute`, no longer as `paid`. Calls before 12 October 2026 still close as `paid`.

assumptions: The brief names no currency, so 'dollars' is used as the default currency word.

Memo of 1 October 2026 overrides rule 32: on hardship the agent says one sentence of sympathy and transfers to queue 'support' straight away without asking (hardship_transfer = direct). The 'no_promise / hardship' codes are kept in events but are not reached in normal flow.

Memo item 2 overrides rule 39 by date: calls with now on or after 2026-10-12 close an 'already paid' case as no_promise / dispute. Before that date it is 'paid'. The base event holds 'paid' and event_changes applies the change. The paid_line (payments can take one business day to appear) is still spoken.
Rule 30 says a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt, so an unclear answer to a payment question counts as a refusal at once (max_unclear = 0, no re-ask).

Band deadlines: early (1-7 days late) is the 12th business day after today, late (8-45) is the 7th business day after today, never counting today. Attempts: early 1, late 2, counted after the opening ask.

Ladder: attempt 1 is the full amount (or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much) on the last business day of this week, or next week's if today is that day. Attempt 2 (late band only) is the floor on the deadline.

If the customer says the full amount is too much, the single floor offer is treated as attempt 1 on attempt 1's date (too_much_floor = attempt_1), because rule 26 says the floor is offered once and attempt 2 'may name the floor again'.
Rule 11: a date given only as numbers is read day-month-year (date_order dmy). It is sent to verify_identity as YYYY-MM-DD.
Three wrong answers in total end the identity check, whatever question they were on. A day_month_swapped hint retry is not counted.

Callbacks: today or the next business day, 10:00-19:00 inclusive, later than now. One re-ask after a time outside the window (max_asks 2). Today's date is not restricted to business days, because the brief says 'today' without qualification.
The brief does not say whether to ask 'anything else' after a recorded promise. The default (one more turn) is kept. The required text-message sentence is said after the promise is recorded.
Brief A never uses add_note, so notes are disabled and every event note is empty.
Brief A covers one product per call. The multi-product defaults are kept but are not expected to apply.
The opening must say the call is recorded. It is phrased in the active voice: 'We record this call.'
Lines avoid the word 'recorded' except in recorded/sms_line/record_failed. Phrases such as 'can accept' are used for limits instead.
A transfer after a recorded promise closes as transferred with that transfer's reason (section 12). This is left to the engine's transfer handling.
